text: Measured against the earlier promise, the apparent difference narrows. Isaac is the child of the covenant, the one through whom the nations are to be blessed; and that promise is here turned into a test. The scene turns upon the single word _hineni_, "here I am," and the language of presence carries in it another sense besides. The word differs with each utterance, and with each it costs more. Abraham says it three times, to God, to Isaac, and to the angel.
